Bank-Prep.question: ১) If 6 workers can build a wall in 10 days, how many workers would be needed to build the same wall in 5 days?
Bank-Prep.exp:
Question: If 6 workers can build a wall in 10 days, how many workers would be needed to build the same wall in 5 days?

Solution: 
6 workers can build a wall in 10 days,
workers would be needed to build the same wall in 5 days = (6 × 10)/5 
= 12 workers

Bank-Prep.question: ২) 210 men working 12 hours a day can finish a job in 18 days. How many men are required to finish the job in 20 days working 14 hours a day?
Bank-Prep.exp:
Question: 210 men working 12 hours a day can finish a job in 18 days. How many men are required to finish the job in 20 days working 14 hours a day?

Solution: 
210 men need (18 × 12) hours
= 216 hours

 to finish the job in 20 days working 14 hours a day men needed = (210 × 216)/(14 × 20)
= 162

Bank-Prep.question: ৩) 3 pumps, working 12 hours a day, can empty a tank in 2 days. How many hours a day must 4 pumps work to empty the tank in 1 day?
Bank-Prep.exp:
Question: 3 pumps, working 12 hours a day, can empty a tank in 2 days. How many hours a day must 4 pumps work to empty the tank in 1 day?

Solution:
3 pumps need 2 days by working 12 hours
1 pump needs 1 day by working 12 × 3 × 2 hours
4 pumps need 1 day by working (12 × 3 × 2)/4 hours
= 18 hours

Bank-Prep.question: ৪) If 12 men or 18 women can reap a field in 7 days, in how many days can 4 men & 8 women reap the same field?
Bank-Prep.exp:
Question: If 12 men or 18 women can reap a field in 7 days, in how many days can 4 men & 8 women reap the same field?

Solution:
12 men = 18 women
1 men = 18/12 women
∴ 4 men = (18 × 4)/12 women = 6 women

4 men + 8 women = 6 women + 8 women
= 14 women

18 women complete the work by 7 days.
1 women complete the work by (18 × 7) days.
∴ 14 women complete the work by (18 × 7)/14 days.
= 9 days

Bank-Prep.question: ৫) Animesh takes twice as much as Bimol or thrice as much time as Rafi to finish a piece of work. Working together, they can finish the work in 3 days. Animesh can do the work alone in -
Bank-Prep.exp:
Question: Animesh takes twice as much as Bimol or thrice as much time as Rafi to finish a piece of work. Working together, they can finish the work in 3 days. Animesh can do the work alone in -

Solution:
Let, Animesh, Bimol, and Rafi take 6x, 6x/2 = 3x, and 6x/3 = 2x respectively.

Now, 
(1/6x) + (1/3x) + (1/2x) = 1/3
⇒ 6/6x = 1/3
⇒ 1/x = 1/3
⇒ x = 3

So, Animesh takes = 6 × 3 = 18 days

Bank-Prep.question: ৬) A certain machine produces 1,000 units of product P per hour. Working continuously at this constant rate, this machine will produce how many units of product P in 7 days?
Bank-Prep.exp:
Question: A certain machine produces 1,000 units of product P per hour. Working continuously at this constant rate, this machine will produce how many units of product P in 7 days?


Solution:
7 days = 7 × 24 hours = 168 hours
In 1 hour, the machine produces 1,000 units
In 168 hours, the machine produces 1,000 × 168  units = 168000 units

Bank-Prep.question: ৭) Akash can do a piece of work in 30 days. He works at it for 6 days and then Rakib finishes it in 18 days. In what time can Akash and Rakib together finish the work?
Bank-Prep.exp:
Question:  Akash can do a piece of work in 30 days. He works at it for 6 days and then Rakib finishes it in 18 days. In what time can Akash and Rakib together finish the work?

Solution: 
আকাশ ৩০ দিনে করে সম্পূর্ণ অংশ 
১ দিনে করে ১/৩০ অংশ 
৬ দিনে করে ৬/৩০ অংশ 
= ১/৫ অংশ 

বাকি থাকে ১ - ১/৫ অংশ 
= ৪/৫ অংশ 

রাকিব ১৮ দিনে করে ৪/৫ অংশ 
১ দিনে করে ২/৪৫ অংশ 

রাকিব ও আকাশ ১ দিনে করে ১/৩০ + ২/৪৫ অংশ 
= ৩ + ৪/৯০ 
= ৭/৯০ 

সম্পুর্ণ কাজ করতে সময় লাগে = ৯০/৭ দিন

Bank-Prep.question: ৮) A and B together can finish a bit of work in 12 days, B and C can do it in 20 days and C and A do it 15 days. A, B and C together can finish it in-
Bank-Prep.exp:
Question: A and B together can finish a bit of work in 12 days, B and C can do it in 20 days and C and A do it 15 days. A, B and C together can finish it in-

Solution: 
(A + B) 1days works =1/12,
(B + C) 1days work =1/20,
(C + A) 1 days work=1/15.

2(A + B + C) 1days work = (1/12 + 1/20 + 1/15)
= (5 + 3 + 4)/60
=12/60
=1/5.

⇒ (A + B + C) 1 days works=1/10.
∴A, B and C together can do it in 10 days

Bank-Prep.question: ৯) Abir does 80% of a work in 20 days. He then calls in Belal and they together finish the remaining work in 3 days. How long Belal alone would take to do the whole work?
Bank-Prep.exp:
Question: Abir does 80% of a work in 20 days. He then calls in Belal and they together finish the remaining work in 3 days. How long Belal alone would take to do the whole work?

Solution: 
abir does 80% or 4/5 work in 20 days 
in one day, he does 1/25 work 
in 3 days, he does 3/25 work 

work remaining = 1/5  - 3/25
= 2/25 work

Belal does 2/25 parts in 3 days 
he will complete the work 75/2 days

Bank-Prep.question: ১০) If two pants and three T-shirts cost Tk. 4000 and three pants and two T-shirts cost Tk. 3500, than how much does a pant cost?
Bank-Prep.exp:
Question: If two pants and three T-shirts cost Tk. 4000 and three pants and two T-shirts cost Tk. 3500, than how much does a pant cost?

Solution: 
মনেকরি 
১টি  pant এর দাম = x টাকা 
১টি T-shirt এর দাম = y টাকা 

এখানে 
2x + 3y = 4000 .......................(1)
3x + 2y = 3500 .......................(2)

From (1) × 2  -  (2) × 3 ⇒
4x + 6y - 9x - 6y = 8000 - 10500
⇒ - 5x = - 2500
∴ x = 500

১টি pant এর দাম = 500 টাকা

Bank-Prep.question: ১১) Mr. Pollob can do a job in 120 minutes, while his colleague can do the same job in 3 hours. How long will it take them to work together to finish the same job?
Bank-Prep.exp:
Question: Mr. Pollob can do a job in 120 minutes, while his colleague can do the same job in 3 hours. How long will it take them to work together to finish the same job?

Solution:
Mr. Pollob can do a job in 120 minutes = 2 hours
∴ Mr. Pollob can do in 1 hour = 1/2 portion of the job

His colleague can do in 1 hour = 1/3 portion of the job

Together they can do in 1 hour = 1/2 + 1/3 = 5/6 portion of the job

∴ Together they can do full job in (6/5) hour = (6 × 60)/5 minutes
= 72 minutes

Bank-Prep.question: ১২) A worker was hired for 7 days. Each day, he was paid Tk. 10 more than what he was paid for the previous day of work. The total amount he was paid in the first 4 days of work equaled the total amount he was paid in the last 3 days. What was his starting pay?
Bank-Prep.exp:
Question: A worker was hired for 7 days. Each day, he was paid Tk. 10 more than what he was paid for the previous day of work. The total amount he was paid in the first 4 days of work equaled the total amount he was paid in the last 3 days. What was his starting pay?

Solution: 
ধরি,
১ম দিন ছিলো x টাকা 

২য় দিন = x + 10
৩য় দিন = (x + 20)
৪র্থ দিন = (x + 30)
৫ম দিন = (x + 40)
৬ষ্ঠ দিন = (x + 50) 
৭ম দিন = (x + 60) টাকা

প্রশ্নমতে,
x + (x + 10) + (x + 20) + (x + 30) = (x + 40) + (x + 50) + (x + 60)
⇒ 4x + 60 = 3x + 150
⇒ 4x - 3x = 150 - 60
∴ x = 90

Bank-Prep.question: ১৩) A map has a scale of 1 cm to 3 km, what length on actual ground does a 3 cm length on the map represent?
Bank-Prep.exp:
Question: A map has a scale of 1 cm to 3 km, what length on actual ground does a 3 cm length on the map represent?

Solution: 
Given that,
1 cm represents 3 km 
∴ 3 cm represent (3 × 3) km 
= 9 km

Question: Piyal can complete a work in 10 days working 8 hours a day. Sajid can complete the same work in 8 days working 10 hours a day. If both piyal and sajid work together,working 8 hours a day,in how many days can they complete the work?

পিয়াল প্রতিদিন ৮ ঘণ্টা করে কাজ করে, ১০ দিনে একটি কাজ করতে পারে।
মোট ঘণ্টা = ১০ × ৮ ঘণ্টা 
= ৮০ ঘণ্টা 

সাজিদ প্রতিদিন ১০ ঘণ্টা করে ৮ দিনে একটি কাজ করতে পারে। 
মোট ঘণ্টা = ১০ × ৮ ঘণ্টা 
= ৮০ ঘণ্টা 

দুইজন একসাথে এক ঘণ্টায় করতে পারে = (১/৮০) + (১/৮০) অংশ 
= ২/৮০ অংশ 
= ১/৪০ অংশ 

সম্পূর্ণ অংশ করতে সময় লাগে = ৪০ ঘণ্টা

Bank-Prep.question: ১৭) Rabbi's regular pay is 30 Taka per hour up to 40 hours. Overtime is twice the payment for regular time. If he was paid 1680 Taka, how many hours of overtime did Rabbi work?
Bank-Prep.exp:
Question: Rabbi's regular pay is 30 Taka per hour up to 40 hours. Overtime is twice the payment for regular time. If he was paid 1680 Taka, how many hours of overtime did Rabbi work?

Solution:
40 ঘন্টার জন্য রাব্বির নিয়মিত বেতন = (30 × 40) = 1200 টাকা।
Overtime এর টাকার পরিমান = (1680 - 1200) টাকা = 480 টাকা
যেহেতু, Overtime এর প্রতিদিনের টাকার পরিমান নিয়মিত বেতন এর দ্বিগুন,
সেহেতু মোট overtime কাজ করার সময় = 480 ÷ (30×2) ঘন্টা = 8 ঘন্টা।

Bank-Prep.question: ১৮) P, Q, and R can do a job in 12 days together.  If their efficiency of working be in the ratio 3 : 8 : 5, Find in what time Q can complete the same work alone?
Bank-Prep.exp:
Question: P, Q, and R can do a job in 12 days together.  If their efficiency of working be in the ratio 3 : 8 : 5, Find in what time Q can complete the same work alone.

Solution: 
Given the ratio of efficiencies of P, Q & R are 3 : 8 : 5
Let, the efficiencies of P, Q & R be 3x, 8x and 5x respectively

They can do work for 12 days.
⇒ Total work = 12 × 16x = 192x


∴ The required time taken by Q to complete the job alone = 192x/8x
= 24 days.

Bank-Prep.question: ১৯) Mamun and Shahin can do a piece of work in 21 and 24 days respectively. They started the work together and after some days Mamun leaves the work and Shahin completes the remaining work in 9 days. After how many days did Mamun leave?
Bank-Prep.exp:
Question: Mamun and Shahin can do a piece of work in 21 and 24 days respectively. They started the work together and after some days Mamun leaves the work and Shahin completes the remaining work in 9 days. After how many days did Mamun leave?

Solution: 
Mamun can do 1/21 work in 1 day

Shahin can do 1/24 work in 1 day
in 9 days, Shahin does 9/24 work
= 3/8 work
remaining work 1 - (3/8)
= (8 - 3)/8
= 5/8 work, which is completed by both.

They both can do (1/21) + (1/24)
= (8 + 7)/168 
= 15/168 work 

15/168 work is done in 1 day 
5/8 work is done (168 × 5)/(15 × 8)
= 7 days

Bank-Prep.question: ২০) Sumi can type 10 pages in 5 minutes. Maria can type 5 pages in. 10 minutes. Working together, how many pages can they type in 30 minutes?
Bank-Prep.exp:
Question: Sumi can type 10 pages in 5 minutes. Maria can type 5 pages in. 10 minutes. Working together, how many pages can they type in 30 minutes?

Solution:
Sumi can type in 1 min = 10/5 = 2 pages 
Maria can type in 1 min = 5/10 = 1/2 page

Working together they can type in 1 min = (2 + 1/2) pages 
= 5/2 pages 

∴ They can type in 30 min = (5 × 30)/2 pages
= 75 pages

২ টি কেরিয়ার ৩ টন মাল বহন করতে সময় নেয় = (১.৫ × ২)/৩ = ১ দিন

Bank-Prep.question: ২২) Machine A produces bolts at a uniform rate of 120 every 40 seconds and Machine B produce bolts at a uniform rate of 100 every 20 seconds. If the two machines run simultaneously, how many seconds will it take for them to produce a total of 200 bolts?
Bank-Prep.exp:
Question: Machine A produces bolts at a uniform rate of 120 every 40 seconds and Machine B produce bolts at a uniform rate of 100 every 20 seconds. If the two machines run simultaneously, how many seconds will it take for them to produce a total of 200 bolts?

Solution:
Given
Machine a produces bolts at a uniform rate of 120 every 40 second
∴ machine a produce 120/40 = 3 bolts per second

Machine b produces bolts at a uniform rate of 100 every 20 second
∴ machine b produces 100/20 = 5 bolts per second

Both machine produce 3 + 5 = 8 bolts running simultaneously per second.

Machine produces 8 bolts for 1 second
∴ For 200 bolts the time taken is 200/8 seconds
= 25 seconds

The machine takes 25 seconds to produce 200 bolts.

Bank-Prep.question: ২৩) If a light flashes every 6 seconds, how many times will it flash in 3/4 of an hour?
Bank-Prep.exp:
Question: If a light flashes every 6 seconds, how many times will it flash in 3/4 of an hour?

Solution:
3/4 of an hour = (3/4) × 3600 seconds
= 2700 seconds

Now,
2700/6 = 450 times

The count start after the first flash. So, the light will flashes 450 + 1 = 451 times

Bank-Prep.exp:
Question: A pump removes water at a rate of 6 gallons per minute. How many hours will it take to remove 1800 gallons?

Solution:
Required time = 1800/6 mins 
= 300/60 hours
= 5 hours

Bank-Prep.question: ২৫) A alone can do a piece of work in 6 days and B alone in 8 days. A and B undertook to do it for 3200 Tk. With the help of C they completed the work in 3 days. How much is to be paid to C?
Bank-Prep.exp:
Question: A alone can do a piece of work in 6 days and B alone in 8 days. A and B undertook to do it for 3200 Tk. With the help of C they completed the work in 3 days. How much is to be paid to C?

Solution:
A ১ দিনে করে ১/৬ অংশ 
B ১ দিনে করে ১/৮ অংশ 

A, B, C ১ দিনে করে ১/৩ অংশ কাজ 

C ১ দিনে করে (১/৩) - (১/৬) - (১/৮)
= ১/২৪ অংশ 

তাদের কাজের অংশের অনুপাত = (১/৬) : (১/৮) : (১/২৪)
= ৪ : ৩ : ১ 

C পাবে = ৩২০০ × ১/(৪ + ৩ + ১)
= ৩২০০/৮ 
= ৪০০ টাকা
